Beta uses screen capture and AccessibilityService only after you choose to start. When you ask for a cart, Beta opens Blinkit first, Swiggy Instamart if Blinkit is not installed, or Zepto if the others are not installed. Keep the grocery app open while Beta works. It reads supported grocery app screens, including visible text, buttons, product names, prices, cart contents, and delivery details such as your name, precise delivery location, delivery address, and locality if they are shown on the screen. Beta sends this screen context to the Beta backend only to build the cart you request. Beta stops before checkout and payment. It does not place orders or pay. You can continue manually or cancel whenever you want. Diagnostic feedback is optional.

Beta needs Accessibility permission before it can help in Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, or Zepto. Android will open Settings. Choose Beta, turn it on, then return to Beta or the grocery app and press the start button again.
